item.title: Top 5 Methods to Solve 'Killed' Errors in Python When Processing Large CSV Files
item.description: When working with large CSV files in Python, it’s not uncommon to encounter the dreaded “Killed” error. This error often occurs when running scripts that involve processing large datasets, causing Python to crash or be terminated unexpectedly. In most cases, the error message will show up in the terminal with a message like “killed (program exited with code: 137)”. But what exactly does this mean, and how can it be solved?
